account: expansion_required is true, so this root node must decompose. The essay task splits cleanly into four independent analytical contributions that can be produced in parallel from the shared brief and general knowledge: (1) pinning down the central term kitsch as a usable yardstick, (2) the strongest affirmative case that AI image generation tends toward kitsch, (3) the strongest counterarguments and complications needed for the mandated nuance, and (4) concrete, widely recognizable examples for texture. None of these needs a sibling's output: the definition can be fixed without knowing which arguments survive, the prosecution and the defense can each be stated in their strongest form independently, and example selection depends only on the brief. The genuinely sequential work — choosing the single defended thesis, structuring the argument, and writing the 550–650 word prose — stays with the parent and is expressed in the synthesis contract; no child drafts a slice of the deliverable.

children.expected_contribution: The working definition and diagnostic criteria of kitsch that the final essay will apply to AI art.
children.no_future_sibling_dependency: Needs only the shared task facts and general cultural knowledge of kitsch; it does not need the affirmative case, the counterarguments, or the examples to fix a definition.
children.objective: Produce a compact, plain-language working definition of kitsch for a general educated reader, plus 3–5 diagnostic marks by which a reader can recognize kitsch (such as pre-digested emotion, formulaic cliche, effortless consumption, reassurance rather than challenge), each explained in one sentence, with brief plain-language historical texture about how the term is ordinarily used in criticism.
children.rationale: The essay's thesis applies the concept of kitsch to AI art; without a fixed, reader-friendly yardstick the argument floats. This child supplies the conceptual tool the parent will wield, in the accessible register the genre demands.

decidability.account: The dossier fully specifies the deliverable: audience, genre, stance posture, form, length range, and title hint are fixed by decisions 1–3, and no external sources exist or are needed. Expansion is mandated by expansion_required; the four proposed children each have bounded, checkable deliverables (word-capped, numbered, plain-language notes) and none depends on a sibling's future output, since each draws only on the duplicated shared facts and general knowledge. The parent's synthesis acceptance condition is mechanically checkable: word count 550–650, presence of a title, a single stated thesis, at least one substantive concession, use of the shared definition and at least two examples.

synthesis_contract.acceptance_condition: The parent produces a titled essay of 550–650 words in plain essay prose, comprehensible standalone to a general educated reader, that states and defends one clear thesis, incorporates at least one substantive concession or complication, uses the shared definition of kitsch and at least two concrete examples from the children, and satisfies demands D1–D4 (length, standalone cultural criticism, argued nuanced thesis, plain prose with title and no citation apparatus).
synthesis_contract.conflict_policy: The parent owns thesis selection. If the affirmative case and the counterarguments pull toward different verdicts, the parent resolves the tension by adopting one concession-structured thesis (for example, kitsch as the default attractor of AI tools rather than an inevitable property of the medium) instead of averaging or hedging into a neutral survey, which decision:2 forbids. Disagreements about emphasis are settled in favor of whatever best serves a single defensible position within the word limit. No child output may override demands D1–D4 or the fixed constraints.
